WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(aa.avg_amount) AS avg_account_amount
    FROM account_averages aa
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = aa.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_account_amount) AS avg_region_amount
    FROM region_averages
)
SELECT ra.region,
       ra.avg_account_amount AS figure,
       ra.avg_account_amount - oa.avg_region_amount AS excess_over_average,
       ra.avg_account_amount / oa.avg_region_amount AS ratio_to_average
FROM region_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ra.avg_account_amount > oa.avg_region_amount;
